revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 3.4%, FY2024 2.8%; modest acceleration from parks/DTC growth, fading toward terminal growth.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 EBIT margin 18.6% (17551/94425), up from 17.1% in FY2024; held at ~19% with slight operating leverage.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: US federal 21% plus state, roughly in line with Disney's normalized effective rate; Damodaran's 3.3% industry effective rate is not used as it is distorted by low-tax firms.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 capex 8.5% of revenue (8024/94425), up from 5.9% in FY2024 on parks/cruise investment; assume gradual easing to 8% average, still above D&A.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 0.859 (Damodaran Entertainment unlevered cash-corrected 0.763, D/E 0.159, tax 21%) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = CoE 8.69%; pretax Kd 5.29% (Damodaran Entertainment) -> 4.18% after-tax; weights 86.3/13.7 (Damodaran industry) -> ~8.1%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal US GDP-like growth, below the 4.86% risk-free rate.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 42,026 (LT debt noncurrent 35,315 + current 6,711) - cash 5,695; no short-term investments reported; 10-K 0001744489-25-000155
